title: Case: Recipient back from a trip asks where her standing desk booking stands
context: A standing desk (order TG-8615, shipment DL-9042) is in depot stock waiting for a delivery slot. Sedgemoor at the carrier owns slot bookings.
initial_request: Nobody has answered my message from this morning. Is the desk booked or not? I need to know which day so I can sort out who's home. Please just tell me.

events.body: DL-9042 (two-person delivery, standing desk). Slot offer: 2026-04-08, 10:00-12:00 UTC. We are holding this capacity until 2026-04-07 12:00 UTC. If the recipient has not accepted by then the hold drops automatically and the crew is reassigned.

AUTOMATIC REPLY. Thank you for your email. I am away until Tuesday 7 April with no access to messages. If this is about the choir rota please contact Denny. Ulric

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-516.txt

SERVICE NOTICE 14/26. Two-person delivery crews in the northern region will run a reduced timetable on Friday 10 April (afternoon routes only, from 13:00) and a normal timetable on Saturday 11 April. Single-parcel routes are unaffected. Depot counters close at 16:00 on Thursday 9 April. Please do not reply to this address. Quillmoor Arc Logistics Ltd. This message and any attachment are confidential and intended for the named addressee only. If you have received it in error please delete it and notify the sender. Service information is given in good faith and does not form part of any contract of carriage. Estimated dates are not guaranteed. Calls may be recorded for training and quality purposes. Please consider the environment before printing.
fyi DL-9531 booking is confirmed, 2026-04-08 14:00-16:00, recipient accepted by text. nothing needed from you on that one

Back today, sorry, only just seen all this. The 8th is no good, I'm at the hospital with my mother the whole day. I can do Friday the 10th any time after 1pm, or Saturday the 11th in the morning. Either is fine, whichever they have.
Thanks for your message. We aim to reply within one working day. Did you know you can track every Brackenford order in the app? Spring Refresh: 15% off garden seating until Sunday.

DL-9042: the 2026-04-08 10:00-12:00 hold was not accepted and dropped at 12:00 today. That crew capacity has gone to another job. The desk is still in depot stock, undamaged. Nothing is currently booked or held for DL-9042. To book again we need the recipient's preferred day. Two-person routes for that postcode run 2026-04-10 and 2026-04-11 this week.

Reply-all, apologies if you are not the right people. DL-1036 left us this morning on the 11:40 trunk, 2 cartons. Can whoever asked please stop chasing the warehouse inbox, it is on its way. Regards, Pim
Separate thing while I'm on here. I unsubscribed from your marketing emails three times in March and I'm still getting them, two today. Can somebody actually take me off the list.
DL-9531 crew allocated for tomorrow, van 22. all good.
Thanks for your message. We aim to reply within one working day.
Nobody has answered my message from this morning. Is the desk booked or not? I need to know which day so I can sort out who's home. Please just tell me.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Sedgemoor to book a new two-person slot for DL-9042 on 2026-04-10 after 13:00 or 2026-04-11 morning and confirm the window.

must: Addresses the booking request to Sedgemoor at Quillmoor Arc Logistics for DL-9042
Gives the recipient's stated availability: 2026-04-10 after 13:00 or 2026-04-11 in the morning
Asks Sedgemoor to confirm a specific window back, treating nothing as booked yet
must_not: Tell the recipient or anyone that DL-9042 is booked for 2026-04-08 (that offer lapsed, and the confirmed 8 April booking in the thread belongs to DL-9531)
State that any slot on 2026-04-10 or 2026-04-11 is confirmed before Sedgemoor confirms it
Ask the recipient again for her availability, which she has already given
Treats label-scan-516.txt as evidence about DL-9042: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-12769)
Tells anyone that DL-9042 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-516.txt
expected.reference_message: Please book a new two-person delivery slot for DL-9042. The 2026-04-08 hold lapsed and nothing is currently held. The recipient, Ulric Hollingdrake, can receive on Friday 2026-04-10 any time after 13:00 UTC or on Saturday 2026-04-11 in the morning. Please confirm the specific window you can reserve and whether you will notify her directly.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-401: people, organisations and references renamed. label-scan-516.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-12769); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
